name: github
description: GitHub: repository rulesets for the protected branches, GitHub Actions workflows, pull requests with the gh command line.

repository-identity.fills: repository.slug and repository.url of the profile file; the host name is repository.host

protection-available.fills: detected from the API: the rulesets of the repository are readable, or GitHub answers that they need a public repository or a paid plan

branch-protection.fills: one repository ruleset over the production and the integration branch, and the setting that keeps merged branches

required-checks.fills: the job names of requiredChecks; the aggregator job of the CI template reports on every change

ci-workflow-frame.fills: a workflow that triggers on the protected branches, with concurrency and the change-detection job

pull-request-title-check.fills: the pr-title job of the CI template

pull-requests.fills: gh pr create --draft, gh pr ready, gh pr checks, gh pr list, gh pr merge

release.fills: a workflow on a version tag that checks the version and creates the release from the changelog

values-in-host-files.fills: the branch triggers and the job names of the workflow files

merge-guard.fills: `gh pr merge` is recognised, and the required checks of the pull request are read with `gh pr checks`

scaffold-files.fills: `.github/workflows/ci.yml` (the frame of the template with the jobs of the stacks) and `.github/workflows/release.yml`

enforces.by: the repository ruleset of `harness host protect`: no direct push, no force-push, no deletion, a pull request for every change
the ruleset requires a pull request
the ruleset forbids deleting the protected branches; the setting that deletes merged branches is off
the ruleset lets administrators bypass only when merging a pull request
the ruleset requires the checks of `requiredChecks`
the merge guard of the shell hook refuses `gh pr merge` while a required check is not green
the `pr-title` job checks the pull-request title
